wargear.name: Night-mantle
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cloak of dark, light-eating fabric stitched with something that was once a man's hide. The model gains Shrouded (5+).

wargear.name: Gibbet standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A frame that carries the last enemy officer the unit caught, still in his armour. Every model in the unit gains Hatred (Infantry).

wargear.name: Siren harness
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A scream-tuned jump pack rig that howls on the descent. Gives the unit Howling Dive.

wargear.name: Atrocity trophies
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A rack of enemy standards, helms and banners. Gives the model Trophy of Terror.

wargear.name: Whisper-warded fetish
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Knotted hair, bone and a murmured curse against the warp. The model gains +1 Willpower and Hexed Mind.

wargear.name: Headsman's chain
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A weighted chain hung with the badges of men executed. Gives the model Headsman's Reckoning.

wargear.name: Grapnel lines
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Wire-line launchers for taking walls and rooftops in a heartbeat. Gives the unit Rooftop Stalkers.

wargear.name: Murk-smoke projectors
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Vents that pour oily dark behind the hull. Gives the vehicle Murk Shroud.

wargear.name: Wailing warsiren
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hull-mounted siren tuned to the pitch of a dying man. Gives the vehicle Dirge of Dread.

The Headsman may take a Headsman's axe

Up to four models may carry a Banshee pistol

The unit may carry a Gibbet standard
The Sergeant may fit a Siren harness
The unit may carry Grapnel lines
The Sergeant may wear a Headsman's chain
Cabal Reliquary: may take up to two relics
May take a Night Lords vehicle fitting
Up to two models may carry a Hook-chain flail
Up to two models may carry a Hook-chain flail
One model may carry a Dread-screamer
The Sergeant may take a Garrote-wire gauntlet

modifiers.text: Night Raptors strike from above and are hit back: +1 I, -1 T.
Terror Squads revel in it and fear it: +1 WS, -1 CL.
The Flay-clade want the knife, not the gun: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Contekar, bitter and unbound: +1 A, -1 LD.

rules.name: Silent Knives
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Knives in the Dark). The sentry never saw the blade. On the turn a unit with this rule enters play from Reserves, enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against it.

rules.name: Dread Herald
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dread Procession). Fear walks ahead of them. An enemy unit charged by a unit with this rule reduces its Cool by a further 1 until the end of that Assault phase.

rules.name: Judgement of the Cabal
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Cabal of Murder). Before deployment, the controlling player names one enemy unit as the Condemned. Models with this rule add +1 to Hit Tests against that unit; if it is destroyed, name another at the start of the next turn.

rules.name: Tithe of Blood
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Headsman's Tithe). When a unit with this rule destroys an enemy unit in combat, every enemy unit within 12" reduces its Cool by 1 until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Howling Dive
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The wail of the dive grinds nerves to powder. Enemy Reaction Shooting against a unit with this rule that has just declared a Charge suffers -1 to Hit, and enemy units it charges lose 1 Cool for that Charge.

rules.name: Trophy of Terror
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Friendly Night Lords units within 6" of this model add +1 to their Cool. Enemy units within 6" of it subtract 1 from their Cool.

rules.name: Hexed Mind
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy psychic powers that target this model or its unit suffer -1 to their Psychic Check.

rules.name: Headsman's Reckoning
rules.text: Legacy house rule. When this model wins a Challenge, or destroys an enemy Sergeant or Character in combat, every enemy unit within 9" loses 1 Cool until the start of its controller's next turn.

rules.name: Rooftop Stalkers
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule ignores Difficult Terrain while charging, and treats a Charge roll of less than 6 as 6 if the Charge crosses or ends in terrain.

rules.name: Murk Shroud
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A vehicle with this rule gains Shrouded (5+) in any turn in which it moved.

rules.name: Dirge of Dread
rules.text: Legacy house rule. At the end of this vehicle's Movement phase, each enemy unit within 12" loses 1 Cool until the end of the turn.

rites.name: Knives in the Dark
rites.flavor: The first sign is a sentry who does not answer the next call.
benefits: Night Raptor Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).

Night Raptors, Reconnaissance Squads and Scout Squads gain Shrouded (6+) and Silent Knives: Outflank, and enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against them on the turn they arrive from Reserves.
limitations: At least one Night Raptor Squad is required.
No Armour units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: Knives in the Dark: Silent Knives, Outflank, Shrouded (6+).

require.note: Bring at least one Night Raptor Squad.

rites.name: Dread Procession
rites.flavor: They did not need to win the battle if the enemy could be persuaded to lose it first.
benefits: Tactical, Despoiler, Veteran Tactical, Assault, Veteran Assault and Reconnaissance Squads gain Fear (1).
Those squads gain Dread Herald: an enemy unit they charge reduces its Cool by a further 1 until the end of that Assault phase.
limitations: No Heavy sub-type Infantry (no Terminators, Breachers or Warders).
No Armour units and no Support units of any kind.

rites.name: Cabal of Murder
rites.flavor: Curze's trusted few do not take orders. They pass judgement on whoever gave them.
benefits: Contekar Terminator Squads and Atramentar Flay-clades may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Judgement of the Cabal: before deployment, name one enemy unit as the Condemned; the Cabal adds +1 to Hit Tests against it.
limitations: Konrad Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
No Armour, Transport or Fast Attack units.

modifiers.text: Cabal of Murder: Line (1), Judgement of the Cabal.

require.note: Curze or Sevatar must lead the Cabal.

rites.name: The Headsman's Tithe
rites.flavor: A world pays in tithe, one way or another. The Eighth Legion simply prefers the other.
benefits: Terror Squads gain Fear (1) and Tithe of Blood: when they destroy an enemy unit in combat, enemy units within 12" reduce their Cool by 1 until the end of the turn.
limitations: Konrad Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
At least two Terror Squads are required.
No Praetors of any kind and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: The Headsman's Tithe: Fear (1), Tithe of Blood.

require.note: Bring at least two Terror Squads.
Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.

armyRules.name: Prey on the Weak
armyRules.condition: vs enemy with a Tactical Status: +1 to Hit in the Assault phase
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Nostramo breeds predators, not soldiers. A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Hit Tests in the Assault phase against enemy units that have a Tactical Status. In exchange, if it is charged by an enemy unit with no Tactical Status, it fights at -1 Initiative in that combat.

armyRules.name: Shadows of Nostramo
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Hunters who live in the dark, and fear the open field. Shooting Attacks made against a unit with this rule from more than 18" suffer -1 to Hit. In exchange, the unit may not make Reaction Shooting.

armyRules.name: Doom Foretold
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Night Haunter's captains speak of judgement as if it were already written. At the start of each Assault phase, one enemy unit within 12" of a model with this rule loses 1 Cool until the end of the phase. If the model is removed as a casualty, every friendly Night Lords unit within 12" must make an immediate Morale Check at -1 Leadership.
